description: Data model for the family tree application. Each top-level key is a table/entity. Field 'type' values are logical types (map to .NET / DB types as appropriate).

BirthLastName.description: Surname at birth, if different from current LastName (e.g. maiden name after marriage). Useful for tracing lineage through name changes.

Gender.description: Used for display purposes (icons/pronouns) in the tree UI. Not used to constrain Parent1/Parent2, which are gender-neutral.

BirthDate.description: Optional because exact birth dates for older ancestors are often unknown.

DateOfDeath.description: Absence does not necessarily mean the person is alive; it may simply be unrecorded.

PictureUrl.description: Single profile picture for v1 (path/URL to stored image).

Biography.description: Free-form notes about the person (occupation, life story, anecdotes, etc.).

Parent1Id.description: Gender-neutral parent reference. No ordering/meaning implied between Parent1 and Parent2.

CreatedByUserId.description: Which family member/account added this record.

UpdatedAt.description: Audit timestamp, set on insert and every update.

Relationship.description: Represents a partnership/marriage between two people. Modeled as its own entity (rather than a single Partner field on Person) so a person can have multiple relationships over their lifetime (e.g. divorce and remarriage), each with its own dates and status.

StartDate.description: e.g. marriage date or start of partnership.

EndDate.description: e.g. divorce date, or date of a partner's death.

User.description: A family member account with login access, used for attribution and edit permissions. Login mechanism (password vs. OAuth) can be decided later without changing this shape.

PasswordHash.description: Optional at the schema level to allow for future OAuth/passwordless login methods that wouldn't populate this field.

PersonId.description: Optional link from a User account to their own Person record in the tree.

Role.description: Simple permission tier: Admin manages users, Editor can add/edit people & relationships, Viewer is read-only.

notes: Children are derived by querying Person rows where Parent1Id or Parent2Id matches a given Person.Id — no separate 'Child' table is needed.
A person's partner(s) are derived by querying Relationship rows where Person1Id or Person2Id matches a given Person.Id.

Deferred for later iterations: multiple photos per person (Photo gallery entity), adoptive/step/biological distinction on parent links, partial/approximate date precision (e.g. 'circa 1920'), privacy flags for living persons.
